item.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption outlines corruption risks in regulatory work and ways to prevent them.
item.support: its focus is on highlighting common corruption risks associated with regulatory work and suggesting some potential ways to prevent corrupt conduct.

item.text: It examines risks created when staff move between regulators and the industries they oversee.
item.support: This term refers to the movement of employees between the regulator (or related government role) and the regulated industry.
